name: Tangent Audio Subvocal Throat Mic Choker
description:
A close-fitting choker with embedded subvocal microphones that pick up throat vibrations from speech too quiet to be audible. The wearer can communicate through mouthing words or whispering at volumes inaudible to anyone standing next to them. From the outside, the choker looks like a simple black band necklace.

Essential equipment for covert operations, undercover work, and the kind of negotiations where being seen talking to your handler would end the conversation — and possibly the speaker.
functionality: Subvocal communication, silent transmission, covert comm
what_it_says: You talk to people no one else knows you're talking to, and the conversation never enters the room.
story_hooks: A subvocal choker recovered from a crime scene is still transmitting — and the receiving end is inside a corponation building that officially has no intelligence operations.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist black choker that sits snugly against the base of the throat. From a distance, it appears as nothing more than a high-fashion neckpiece—elegant and understated. Up close, the surface reveals subtle sensor nodes and micro-mesh patterns barely visible against the matte black finish. Worn by operatives, fixers, and corpo intelligence assets who need deniable communication.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fit around the neck, conforming to the wearer's throat contours without restricting movement. Designed for extended wear without discomfort. Sits approximately 1-2 inches below the jawline.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-grade synthetic polymer core with integrated bio-reactive sensor mesh and carbon-weave threading. The outer surface is treated with light-absorbing nano-coating to minimize reflectivity.
physical_description.texture: Smooth matte finish with imperceptible raised nodes along the interior contact points where microphones nest against the skin. The underside is slightly tacky to prevent slipping from perspiration or augmentation fluid.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black throughout, with occasional silver or gunmetal accent nodes barely perceptible in direct light. Some street models feature faint neo-noir iconography laser-etched into the band.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closure on one side, hidden beneath the choker's seamless design. Friction-fit adjustment for perfect throat contour.
distinctive_features: Sound dampening internal lining to prevent acoustic feedback
Minimal visible tech—designed for plausible deniability
Tangent Audio logo subtly embossed on inner surface only
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corpo luxury / Tier 3 professional operative. Premium black-market variants reach Tier 2 pricing. Street knockoffs exist at Tier 4-5 but lack reliability.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate intelligence operatives, undercover fixers, military wetwork teams, and anyone conducting sensitive negotiations where audio surveillance is a threat. Signals expertise, operational security awareness, and access to high-end comms gear. Rarely worn openly by legitimate professionals—possession is often incriminating.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops subtle wear patterns (faint neck indentation marks, minor micro-scratches) with heavy use. Well-maintained units show no visible degradation. Heavily-used street models may show sensor drift or magnetic closure fatigue.
